gloss: to see clearly; to discern; to ascertain

definitions.gloss: to discern; to ascertain; to see through
definitions.explanation: To carefully judge or determine the true nature, quality, or value of something.

examples.japanese: {本物|ほんもの}かどうか{見極|みきわ}める。
{状況|じょうきょう}を{見極|みきわ}めてから{行動|こうどう}する。
examples.english: I'll act after ascertaining the situation.

examples.japanese: {相手|あいて}の{本心|ほんしん}を{見極|みきわ}めるのは{難|むずか}しい。
examples.english: It's difficult to discern someone's true feelings.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
{他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
Pattern: [something]を{見極|みきわ}める

ASPECT:
{見極|みきわ}めている typically indicates an ongoing process of discernment.

CONJUGATION:
・{見極|みきわ}めない (negative)
・{見極|みきわ}めて (te-form)
・{見極|みきわ}めた (past)

COLLOCATIONS:
・{真偽|しんぎ}を{見極|みきわ}める - to discern truth from falsehood
・{本質|ほんしつ}を{見極|みきわ}める - to see through to the essence
・タイミングを{見極|みきわ}める - to judge the timing
・{可能性|かのうせい}を{見極|みきわ}める - to assess the possibilities

COMPOUND VERB:
{見|み} (see) + {極|きわ}める (to reach the extreme/master) → to see to the core

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{見抜|みぬ}く - to see through (deception)
・{判断|はんだん}する - to judge
